import base64
import hashlib
import io
import json
import subprocess
import tempfile
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path

source = Path('products/distribution/sqlite-gumroad-fit/private-exercise')
output = source / 'delivery'
output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
names = ['invoice-regression.py', 'invoice-fixtures.json']
files = {name: (source / name).read_bytes() for name in names}
verification = source / 'verification.json'
archive = io.BytesIO()
with zipfile.ZipFile(archive, 'w', compression=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as bundle:
    for name, content in files.items():
        member = zipfile.ZipInfo(name)
        member.compress_type = zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED
        member.external_attr = 0o644 << 16
        bundle.writestr(member, content)
archive_bytes = archive.getvalue()
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
    with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(archive_bytes)) as bundle:
        assert bundle.namelist() == names and bundle.testzip() is None
        for name in names:
            assert bundle.read(name) == files[name]
        bundle.extractall(directory)
    subprocess.run(['python3', '-m', 'py_compile', names[0]], cwd=directory, check=True)
    json.loads((Path(directory) / names[1]).read_bytes())
encoded = base64.b64encode(archive_bytes)
assert base64.b64decode(encoded, validate=True) == archive_bytes
(output / 'invoice-regression.zip.b64').write_bytes(encoded + b'\n')
manifest = {'status': 'PRIVATE_DELIVERY_CANDIDATE', 'archive_sha256': hashlib.sha256(archive_bytes).hexdigest(), 'files': {name: hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest() for name, content in files.items()}, 'prior_behavior_verification_sha256': hashlib.sha256(verification.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'checks': ['archive CRC', 'exact two-member inventory', 'source byte equality', 'clean extraction', 'Python compilation', 'fixture JSON parsing', 'base64 round trip'], 'remaining_before_handoff': ['Confirm usage instructions and terms for the exact package.', 'Verify marketplace product and Canadian payout eligibility before proposing activation.']}
report = output / 'archive-verification.json'
report.write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
print(report.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
